verificationNotes: One initial batched UI inspection, one broad confirmation, then targeted defect checks only.
Sidebar footer specificity and feedback animation hit-testing were repaired and checked at 320/360 px.
Map wire and pause checks wait for actual asynchronous completion.
A failed Chrome startup and an isolated demo initialization timeout were retried; the feedback-cycle check subsequently passed.
No model latency or accuracy benchmark was rerun.
knownLimits: Chrome native APIs do not provide an atomic compare-and-set for arbitrary concurrent external tab changes.
Windows, Edge, Chrome 120, prolonged real browsing and large-scale grouping quality were not revalidated.
